title: In Spite Of, Despite, Although, Even Though, Though — Improve Your Grammar
skills: distinguish among in spite of, despite, although, even though, and though
use concessive words and phrases to express contrast accurately

alignment_note: Explains how common concessive words and phrases express contrast and how their grammatical structures differ. Supports sentence variety, cohesion, transition use, grammar accuracy, and formal informational or academic writing across high school English courses, with useful reinforcement for multilingual learners.
